cohort: The study included multigravida women with singleton pregnancies after 28 weeks of gestation who delivered in a tertiary care hospital and had a previous birth.
finding: Women with short interpregnancy interval (<=18 months) had higher rates of preterm births and low birth weight babies, while those with interpregnancy interval >18 months showed increased rates of pregnancy-induced hypertension, hypothyroidism, and gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was a common indication for cesarean section among women with a short interpregnancy interval.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from September 1st, 2023 to January 30th, 2024.
gest_age: Babies after 28 weeks of gestation were included.
